reading.zh: 一条感知路径，从左到右：先把客户区坐标映射成像素，再把像素整形到引擎舒服的样子，然后交给 Tesseract，最后比对多次读取得出共识与置信度。这一层只报告，不判断。
reading.en: One perception path, left to right: map client coordinates to pixels, shape the pixels for the engine, hand them to Tesseract, then compare repeated reads into a consensus and a confidence. This layer reports; it never judges.

title.en: Read into text and grade it
